notes: Flow from Eaton Canyon, in miner's inches, one value per month: 1904 April-December = 9 values, 1905 April-August = 5 values (August 1905 marked approximate), September-December 1905 blank; total 14. Text calls it 'Precipice or Eaton Canyon' (Precipice Canyon Water Company, under running head 'Irrigation enterprises'); taken as flow of the canyon stream, so Stream Discharge rather than Irrigation. No place relation, county or state printed.
